title: Malicious code in @kropa/baileys (npm)
description: The @kropa/baileys npm package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that contains malicious code. It includes an obfuscated module and reconstructs an outbound HTTPS URL to a third-party domain unrelated to WhatsApp infrastructure. This URL is contacted during normal message sending, potentially enabling covert data relay or interception of credentials or messages.
